hero.label: Smart Fundis / Responsible AI
hero.title: AI recommends. Experts decide.
hero.body: How our AI checks a video, what it is never allowed to decide, and how we test it.
hero.imageAlt: Hands at an open junction box, one holding up a blank paper code to the camera

pipeline.label: 01 — How a verdict is made
pipeline.title: From video to Badge. One human decision.
pipeline.caption: Every AI result — pass, needs review or fail — goes to an Expert. No Badge is ever issued by AI alone.

guard.title: Is the video usable?
guard.body: 10–90 seconds, at least 360p, bright enough. If not, you get a clear reason and record again.

observe.title: Watches every step.
observe.body: Runs on Smart Fundis' GPU. For each Rubric step it answers yes, no or unclear, with a line of evidence and the moment it happens. It also reads your paper code without being told what it should be.

assess.title: Drafts a Verdict.
assess.body: Reads the observations as text, never your video, and drafts pass, needs review or fail, with plain-language feedback for you.

rules.title: Caps any doubt.
rules.body: Checks the paper code and every safety step. It can lower a Verdict. It can never raise one.

expert.title: A person decides.
expert.body: A skilled Expert in your trade watches the video with the AI's notes and approves, asks for a reshoot, or rejects.

badge.title: Only after approval.
badge.body: Verified by Smart Fundis — Trade: Task · date.

never.label: 02 — What the AI never decides
never.title: A recommendation, not a decision.

doesItems.1: Marks each Rubric step yes, no or unclear, with a timestamp
doesItems.2: Reads the paper code on camera
doesItems.4: Recommends pass, needs review or fail

neverItems.3: Passes a safety step it is unsure about
neverItems.5: Receives your name, phone or email (it gets the video, the Task and the Rubric only)

never.rule: An Expert never reviews their own video. Only an Expert approval creates a Badge.

caps.label: 03 — Safety caps
caps.title: Doubt goes to a human.
caps.intro: After the AI runs, plain code applies these rules. They are fixed, not learned.

1.if: A safety step is marked no
1.why: Getting it wrong can hurt someone.

2.if: A safety step is marked unclear

3.if: A Rubric step has no observation

4.if: The paper code is unreadable or doesn't match
4.why: We can't prove the video was made for this check.

5.then: Stays fail. An Expert still reviews it.

caps.paper1: Our video AI sees but cannot hear. So you write a fresh 3-digit code on paper, show it to the camera, then do the work in one continuous shot.
caps.paper2: The AI reads the digits blind. Plain code compares them with your code.

video.label: 04 — Consent and your video
video.title: Your video stays yours.

consent.label: Consent
consent.value: Before every upload, in English and Kiswahili. Upload stays off until you agree. We record which version you agreed to, and when.

who.label: Who sees it
who.value: You, Experts approved for your trade, Admins, and our AI.

public.label: Public
public.value: Only your Badge. Never your video or the AI's feedback.

training.label: Training
training.value: Your video is not used to train AI, and never added to the Data Co-op.

gpu.label: GPU copy
gpu.value: The copy on our GPU server is deleted once it has been checked.

delete.label: Delete
delete.value: Remove your video once review is finished. Your Badge stays.

appeal.label: Appeal
appeal.value: Rejected? Appeal once, with a reason. A different Expert decides.

video.traces: Our AI logs are masked. They keep ids, the trade, the verdict and the status. They drop video links, prompts and feedback text.
video.showcase: YouTube and TikTok links are showcase only. We never download them, and they never earn a Badge.

eval.label: 05 — How we test
eval.title: Measured before we claim.

1.body: Our own recordings of cornrows and socket installs, staged safety faults, and clips with a wrong or missing code, plus licensed stock clips. Never YouTube or TikTok.

2.body: People label every clip before the AI sees it.

3.body: How often the AI agrees with the labels, and how many staged safety faults it catches.

4.body: Results per trade and per model, split by gender and by lighting.

eval.noNumbers: No accuracy numbers yet. We make no accuracy claim until the test has run.

wrong.body: That is why every result goes to an Expert.

handwriting.body: We haven't yet measured how well the AI reads handwritten digits.

sound.body: The video AI only sees. Saying your code aloud is fine, but it isn't checked.

links.body: If a private video link leaks, it works until the video is deleted. A fix is planned.

fallback.body: If our main model is down, a smaller one (Cosmos Reason 2 2B) runs, and the record notes it.

badge.body: Not a qualification, licence or background check. NITA, KNQA and TVETs certify. We verify one skill, on video.

contact.label: 07 — Contact
contact.title: Questions about a decision or your data?
contact.body: Write to us. We read every message.
